findings.text: PCI bus to CPU mask mapping selects the global CPU mask when the bus has no NUMA node and otherwise selects the mask of the bus node.
Architecture frequency scaling interface is aliased to topology layer operations for tick update, scale set, capacity query, invariant query and reference query.
Architecture CPU capacity, topology refresh and hardware pressure interfaces are aliases to corresponding topology layer getters and updaters.
Threaded CPU test reports whether the current MPIDR value carries the MT topology bit.
Transient page table allocator bundle holds a page allocator callback plus an opaque argument passed to that callback.
Deprecated ARMv8 instruction emulation hook unconditionally declines emulation for the supplied registers and opcode.
IRQ-entry and generic entry address tests return true exactly when the address lies inside their respective linker delimited text ranges with inclusive lower and exclusive upper bounds.
RAS SError classifier rejects ESR values with implementation defined syndrome, otherwise reports presence of the RAS extension as the RAS decision and asserts non preemptible context.
RAS SError severity extraction returns uncategorized when the ESR is not a RAS SError or when its fault status is not SError, otherwise returns the AET field from the ESR.

MOPS exception register fixup decodes wrong-option, option, memory versus copy class, destination, source and size selectors plus epilogue state from ESR, then rewrites user registers and program counter backward so the operation can be reissued in prologue form, with distinct forward and backward copy handling.

Checked user load path validates the pointer range, masks the address, enables user access, performs a size selected unprivileged load with fault redirection, then disables user access; failure yields zero value and fault status.

Checked user store path validates the pointer range, masks the address, enables user access, performs a size selected unprivileged store with fault redirection, then disables user access; failure reports fault status.
Kernel no-fault copy primitives bracket a privileged size selected load or store with asynchronous tag-check override enable and disable and redirect any fault to a caller supplied error label.
Raw user block copy in either direction masks the user side pointer and holds the user access window open across the underlying arch copy, returning the residual byte count.

Unsafe user access window begins only after range validation and enables access, ends by disabling access, while the unsafe single item helpers perform masked unprivileged access with caller supplied fault label.
User access save and restore are inert and carry no state.
Inline unsafe user copy drains the length using progressively narrower accesses in 64 then 32 then 16 then 8 bit units, advancing both pointers and jumping to a caller label on fault.

Architecture user clear routine zeroes a user range and returns the number of bytes left uncleared after a fault, using bulk, word, halfword and byte stores plus exception fixups that compute the residue from start and end pointers.
Generic user clear wrapper only invokes the arch clear inside a validated range and an enabled user access window with masked pointer, otherwise returns the full requested length.
Flushcache user copy reads from the masked user source through the raw path and then cleans the data cache over exactly the bytes successfully copied.

Subpage writability probe is inert without MTE support and otherwise samples the first byte plus each tag granule start in the range, returning remaining bytes from the fault point on failure and zero on success.

Architecture requests legacy and compat syscall variants including compat stat forms, hostname, pause, getpgrp, nice, sigpending, sigprocmask, compat sendfile, 32 bit time, fork, vfork, clone and new stat.
Compat private syscall base and selected numbers plus total syscall count and a 32 bit file range alias are fixed ABI facts.

Uprobe breakpoint uses a fixed 32 bit breakpoint encoding with instruction and execution slot sizes equal to one AArch64 instruction; task state is empty while probe state holds either saved or out of line opcode plus decode metadata and a simulate flag.
Uprobe single step handler takes registers and ESR and unconditionally reports the debug hook error outcome.

VDSO occupies four pages, resolves symbols by adding a per symbol offset to a base, supports archtimer clocks with a no-compat variant, and compat time support advertises clock getres and 32 bit VDSO build.
32 bit compat barriers map full, read and write SMP ordering onto inner shareable domain barrier variants.
Compat VDSO time fallbacks issue a supervisor call with arguments in low registers and the compat clock or time syscall number selected by the requested operation, returning the kernel result.

Compat VDSO counter read is valid only for archtimer mode and otherwise yields zero so the caller retries; the valid path fences counter sampling on both sides and the clock is accepted only in archtimer mode while time data is obtained through an indirection that preserves one relocation.

User memory helpers require strict pairing of access window enable and disable on both success and fault paths, plus tag override pairing for kernel no-fault access; incorrect pairing leaks access state or tag checking behavior.

RAS classification assumes non preemptible execution and MOPS fixup mutates destination, source, size and program counter in place, so callers must supply genuine user register state and preserve ESR decoding inputs.
